SplitButton.use: one stable primary action next to a menu of related actions

rules.primary: The primary action, onClick and the button's own children, never changes based on the menu selection. If there is no single dominant action, use Menu alone instead.
rules.menuItems: Give every item a stable value and label, same shape as Menu's items.
rules.menuLabel: menuLabel names the adjacent menu trigger for assistive tech since it has no visible text.
